# Excalidraw Common Tests

This layer contains test files for various common utilities and data structures used throughout the Excalidraw project.

## Overview

Contains test files for various common utilities and data structures.

## Responsibilities

- **Data Structures**: Test the functionality of data structures like binary heaps, queues, and URL normalization.
